map.不放回抽样下成功次数的概率计算: Probability of the number of successes under sampling without replacement
map.输入总体 N、总体中成功数 K、抽取数 n 与目标 k: Enter the population N, the number of successes K in the population, the number drawn n and the target k
map.给出期望与方差，用于评估抽检方案: Gives the expectation and variance for evaluating a sampling plan
map.区别于二项分布：不放回时各次不再独立: Difference from the binomial distribution: without replacement, the draws are no longer independent
map.不放回抽样（如从 N 件含 K 件次品中抽 n 件）的成功次数。: The number of successes when sampling without replacement (such as drawing n items from N items containing K defectives).
map.质检抽检：从 1000 件（含 30 件次品）中抽 50 件，算「一件次品都没抽: Quality inspection sampling: from 1000 items (including 30 defectives) draw 50 and compute the probability of drawing no defectives at all, to evaluate whether this sampling plan can catch problems.
map.填总体容量 N（如 1000 件）: Enter the population size N (such as 1000 items)
map.填总体中的「成功」数 K（如 30 件次品）: Enter the number of "successes" K in the population (such as 30 defectives)
map.填抽取数 n（如抽 50 件），注意是不放回: Enter the number drawn n (such as 50 items), noting that sampling is without replacement
map.填目标 k 并选择口径（常算「抽到 0 件次品」的概率）: Enter the target k and choose the probability type (commonly the probability of drawing 0 defectives)
map.若该概率偏高，说明抽检方案抓不到问题，需要加大 n: If this probability is high, the sampling plan cannot catch problems and n needs to be increased
map.当总体 N 远大于抽样量 n（通常 n/N < 0.05）时，不放回与放回的差异: When the population N is much larger than the sample size n (usually n/N < 0.05), the difference between sampling with and without replacement can be ignored and the binomial approximation is enough, which is simpler to compute
map.抽样比例较高时必须用超几何分布，否则会高估方差、低估抽到次品的概率: When the sampling fraction is high, the hypergeometric distribution must be used, otherwise the variance is overestimated and the probability of drawing a defective is underestimated
map.超几何与二项区别？: Difference between the hypergeometric and binomial distributions?
map.超几何不放回、概率随抽样变化；二项放回、概率恒定。: The hypergeometric distribution is without replacement, so the probability changes as you draw; the binomial is with replacement, so the probability stays constant.
map.什么时候可以当作二项分布算？: When can it be calculated as a binomial distribution?
map.当总体 N 远大于抽样量 n（通常 n/N < 0.05）时，不放回与放回的差异: When the population N is much larger than the sample size n (usually n/N < 0.05), the difference between sampling with and without replacement can be ignored and the binomial approximation is enough, which is simpler to compute. When the sampling fraction is high, the hypergeometric distribution must be used, otherwise the variance is overestimated and the probability of drawing a defective is underestimated.
